aReinforcedHeavyCamperDesigned: A reinforced heavy camper designed to endure wilderness tours and long journeys. Demands high overall structural integrity.
aClassicStandardEngineTransport: A classic standard engine transport suited for urban environments. Relies on tight steering and transmission control.
anAgileAndRapidPersonal: An agile and rapid personal sport bike. Requires perfect chain lubrication and brake responsiveness.
anAdvancedDeepSpaceExplorer: An advanced deep-space explorer equipped with hyper-navigation drives. Critical parts must be flawless to permit ascent.
aLightPackableBoatFor: A light packable boat for open water. Its hull and air chambers must stay intact to keep it afloat.
allCriticalComponentsMustMaintain: All critical components must maintain above 0% integrity to operate.

accel.name: Turbo Injectors
accel.desc: Sharper throttle response and quicker acceleration.

speed.name: Aero Streamlining
speed.desc: Higher top speed and less game-time spent crossing each world tile.

fuel.desc: A larger reservoir raises the maximum fuel capacity.

health.desc: A hardened frame makes the vehicle take less damage from impacts.

aquatic.name: Amphibious Conversion
aquatic.desc: A sealed hull and pontoons let the camper drive on and dive beneath water.

flight.name: Antigravity Rotors
flight.desc: Fold-out antigravity rotors let the camper take off and fly.

enablesDrivingOnAndDiving: Enables driving on and diving under water.
